Thirty-eight chapters

Thirty-eight doors. None of them locked.

Plenty of people are building a god's-eye view of the world — everything watched, from orbit, by somebody else.

This is the opposite picture. Not looking down at people. Standing at street level with the door held open, in their language, for free.

 

Chapters. Choosing one turns the globe to it.

Drag the globe, or tab through the list. The land is Natural Earth 110m, drawn as halftone rather than as a map — it is a motif, not an instrument. Chapter locations here are illustrative placeholders.

Paper, thread, ink

A brand you can hold.

Most of this identity ends its life as a physical object in somebody's hands: a flyer off a tired photocopier, a patch on a volunteer's sleeve. It is built to survive that, which is why the mark is flat, heavy and made of one shape.

The future belongs to all of us.

Every asset on this page is generated from one definition of the mark and one palette. Nothing here was drawn by hand twice.
